lesson.title: Educational level and examination monitoring
lesson.summary: Recognise educational-level assessment and exam-behaviour monitoring without conflating them.

prerequisites.reason: The learner must distinguish a listed-use match from the product route.

blocks: **Educational-level assessment** concerns deciding the appropriate level of education a person receives or can access in or within educational and vocational institutions at all levels.

An institution's AI deciding which level of programme a learner can enter illustrates the purpose. Voluntary study advice outside that institutional decision requires its own factual comparison rather than inheriting this case's result.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(c), 3(d); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: **Examination monitoring** includes AI monitoring and detecting prohibited student behaviour during tests in or within these institutions.
A fictional exam tool flagging suspected prohibited conduct is relevant even if a teacher later reviews its output. A human in the workflow does not automatically remove the listed intended purpose.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(c), 3(d); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: Keep purpose and reliability separate. A product can have the relevant listed purpose while its claims about accuracy remain unproven. Record both what it is designed to do and how its output affects people.
Northbridge records whether a flag is shown, ignored, investigated or used to stop an exam. Those downstream consequences matter to the later significant-risk and decision-influence analysis.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(c), 3(d); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: In a combined system, identify level-placement and exam-monitoring functions separately. Compare their institutional facts with points 3(c) and 3(d); then examine the remaining legal tests.
Calling a monitoring system 'student support' does not alter its actual conduct-detection purpose. Equally, do not claim every camera or every study tool fits the point without those facts.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(c), 3(d); Article 6(2), 6(3)

questions.prompt: An institution's AI assesses which level of education an individual can access. Which function is indicated?

options.reason: Point 3(c) concerns the appropriate level received or accessible.
Monitoring test behaviour is a separate purpose.
Room logistics do not establish educational-level decisions.
